title: Fabric Inbox agent event — data.value (B-118)
description: What a reply agent did with one incoming message, as the agent-events feed carries it (list_agent_events; fabric-service/0.1 events page, data.value). Never the sender, the subject or any message text: the question is the model's paraphrase, written without personal data.

runId.description: The run; list_agent_runs runId reads it

address.description: The agent address the message was sent to

intent.description: One or two words for what the sender wanted

grounded.description: Every fact in the answer came from the agent's knowledge or tools

unanswered.description: The knowledge had no confident answer, or the answer could not be grounded

question.description: Only when unanswered: what the person wanted to know, paraphrased in English without personal data

sources.description: Titles of the passages the agent was given
